## Goal
Replace the partial impl-repair evidence entry with one complete workflow-owned proof for each applied finding.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every applied finding gets exactly one complete proof with R1 fields.
- The proof values bind to the current review, repair, and passing validation artifacts.
- Generic issue-log diagnostics remain outside the proof producer.
- Task gates remain pre-validation checks and do not require the post-validation proof; integration gate readiness owns that R2 verification.

## Implementation Notes
Extend recordAppliedFindingRepairEvidence so its issue-log payload contains every R1 field and is validated by RepairEvidenceReference. Preserve the canonical review scope in the proof; do not add post-validation proof enforcement to task gates. The audited preimplementation-bootstrap recovery is intentionally single-purpose: when existing implementation-target changes precede scenario validity, it records those exact paths, skips only scenario-validity and test-review, and retains test-execute, integration gate, and final-regression verification.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests construct valid and invalid proof inputs and verify persisted issue-log entries.
